doc.title: Al Tinney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002

title: What matters most: a good woman
summary: Asked what is most important, he says a good woman and jokes about getting duds.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: You’ve had quite an amazing life. If you think about your life, what’s the most important thing for you? That’s a heck of a question isn’t it? But I’m wondering if you have a —
Yeah that is quite a question. What’s important to me?

That’s funny you said that. A good woman. A good woman to most men. A good woman. I just heard something recently, a guy said if you have a good woman you have a good life. If you have a bad woman, or a woman that ain’t up to par, you’ll become a great philosopher. Because you start making things out of situations. So I believe that’s all I’m looking for. When I find that I’ll be all right.
Yeah. But so far it hasn’t happened, in 81 years. I keep getting duds.
Duds. One dud after the other.
Well it gives you something to look forward to I guess.
Yes. Maybe that’s why I’m still alive.
Yes. You can’t rush things I guess.
Yes indeed. I just say Al, you really don’t need it, I don’t know why you’re looking for it. Looking for something you don’t need. But I think I need it. I can stand on the corner and talk about it.
